en: Sir Aldric of the Greenwood road, at your service. Nobody gets past me.
A shield is only as good as the arm behind it. Mine will not tire.
Ready when you are, commander.
I polished the shield again. You can see the trees in it.
Stand behind me. That is the whole plan, and it works.
Stronger! The road will be safer for it.
I feel like I could hold a bridge alone. Please do not test that.
Shields up! Form on me!
Whatever comes out of those trees, we face it together.
Shield bash!
Stay down!
Here is a door you will not open!
One less threat on the road.
Yield next time.
I am... still standing.
The armor took most of it. Most.
No! Hold the line, I have you!
They fell on my watch. Not again.
The road is clear. Onward!
Well fought, everyone. Not a scratch on the shield.
Another stretch of road made safe.
Fall back... we regroup and return.
I will be stronger next time. I swear it.
Lyra. I never miss twice, and I rarely miss once.
Point me at the goblins. I will handle the rest.
Eyes up. Something is always watching.
I counted the arrows. Twice. Fine, three times.
Aldric is slow, but he makes a lovely wall.
My aim feels sharper. Frighteningly sharper.
New string, new feathers, same deadly me.
I see them. They do not see me.
Pick a target. I will pick three.
Volley!
Rain of arrows!
Duck. Oh, too late.
Bullseye.
That one was for the road.
Somebody cover me!
That was a little too close.
I will avenge you, I promise.
Who let them get that close?!
Not a single arrow wasted. Well, almost.
I win the kill count. Again.
Let us keep moving before more show up.
Too many of them. Pull back!
I needed more arrows. And more friends.
I am Pip! I know nine spells. Six of them on purpose!
My master said I was ready. Well, she said I was 'technically alive'.
Did you know fire is just very excited air?
I only set my hat on fire once today. Progress!
Want to see a trick? No? Fair.
Ooh! I can feel the magic tingling in my toes!
New spell unlocked! I think. Someone stand back.
Okay, okay, I have got this. Probably!
Everybody stand behind Aldric. Even me.
Fireball! It worked! IT WORKED!
Ignis... something... FIREBALL!
Hot, hot, hot!
Did I do that? I did that!
Sorry! Not sorry!
Ow, ow, owww! Is that normal?
I would like to retire now, please.
No no no! Somebody heal them!
I should have studied harder!
We won! I am writing this down!
Nobody tell my master about the smoke.
That was the best thing ever!
Next time I will read the whole spellbook. Maybe.
I think I blew up the wrong side...
Sister Maren of the mountain abbey. Bring me your wounded.
I go where the hurt is. It seems to be wherever you are.
Breathe. You are safe here, for now.
Pip, please stop setting things on fire.
Light walks with us, even into the crypts.
My light burns brighter. Thank you.
I can mend deeper wounds now. Let us hope I need not.
Stay close. I cannot heal what I cannot reach.
Courage. I am right behind you.
Mending light!
Be whole again.
Not today. You are not falling today.
Rest now, and trouble no one.
May you find a gentler road.
Even healers bleed, it seems.
Someone... protect the healer, please.
Hold on! I am coming!
I was too slow. Forgive me.
Everyone is accounted for. Good.
Sit down, all of you. Bandages first, celebrating later.
The light held.
We live. That is what matters. We will try again.
Retreat, and let me tend to you.
Vex. I work for coin. Occasionally for friends. You are paying, right?
You will not hear me coming. That is the point.
What? I was not touching your purse.
Shadows are just pockets of free real estate.
Paladin keeps glaring at me. I like it.
Faster hands, sharper knives. Good investment.
I am worth every coin. Now even more.
Keep them busy. I will take care of the rest.
Mark the rich-looking one for me.
Behind you.
Backstab! Classic.
Never saw me, did you?
I will be taking that.
Quiet and clean.
This is not what I signed up for!
Time to vanish. Any second now.
Hey! Nobody hits my friends but me!
Fine. Now it is personal.
Loot first, speeches later.
Told you I was worth it.
Not bad. For heroes.
Run now, steal back our dignity later.
I am charging extra for this one.
I am Seraphine. My shield has never broken, and it will not start today.
Where the dark gathers, I stand. Lead on.
Faith is a shield you carry on the inside.
Vex, I can see you behind that pillar.
Every dawn is a promise. I intend to keep it.
My oath grows stronger. So does my arm.
Radiant. Unbroken. Ready.
By the dawn, we stand!
Shields together. None shall fall.
Aegis!
Light, shelter them!
Stand within my shield!
Darkness recedes.
Be judged.
Bent, not broken.
My shield holds. I will hold.
You will not have them! Not while I stand!
Rise, friend. Your fight is not over.
The light prevails.
Not a single crack. As promised.
Gather the wounded. We march at dawn.
A shield can retreat and still be unbroken.
We will return, stronger. That is my oath.
Kael. The forest raised me. It taught me to hunt.
Wolves trust me. Goblins should not.
Wind is from the north. Good for tracking.
You walk too loud.
Lyra thinks she is the better shot. She is wrong.
Sharper senses. The forest approves.
Good. The hunt gets easier.
Prey sighted.
Quiet. Let them come to us.
Marked.
Hunter's mark! You cannot hide.
Found your weak spot.
Clean shot.
The hunt ends.
Wounded animals bite harder.
Not my first scar.
Pack down! Close ranks!
They will pay for that.
Good hunt.
We eat well tonight.
The forest is quieter now.
Even the wolf retreats to hunt again.
We were the prey this time.
I am Zara Stormcaller. I speak, and the sky answers.
You summoned me? How bold. I approve.
Do you smell that? Rain. And ozone. Lovely.
Pip, that is not how lightning works. Watch.
The clouds are restless. So am I.
The thunder grows louder. Excellent.
More power. The storm never says no to more.
Let the sky decide your fate.
Storm's coming. It is me.
Chain lightning!
Sky, answer me!
Feel the storm!
Struck down.
Lightning never misses. Neither do I.
How dare you.
The eye of the storm is... uncomfortable.
You will regret that. Loudly.
Thunder, avenge them!
The storm passes. As it always does.
Applause is acceptable.
Clear skies. For now.
Even storms must break.
This is merely the calm before my return.
Fennick, bard extraordinaire! My songs make cowards brave and heroes braver.
Finally, an audience worth playing for!
I am composing a ballad about you. It needs a dramatic ending.
What rhymes with 'Lich'? Asking for a song.
Request a tune? Anything but the goblin anthem.
A new verse! A new chorus! A new ME!
My lute sings sweeter. Do not tell the lute I said so.
And a one, and a two...
Time for a battle hymn!
Battle anthem! Sing along!
Louder, everyone! LOUDER!
This one goes out to the brave!
And the crowd goes wild!
A tragic ending. For them.
The show must go on... right?
I am too handsome to die!
No! You were my best verse!
A sad song, then. A furious sad song!
Encore! Encore!
That is going in the ballad.
Bow, everyone! Take a bow!
Every great ballad has a sad second act.
We will rewrite this ending.
I am Drakon, last rider of the red dragons. My fire is yours.
The dragons are gone. Their fury is not.
The sky felt bigger with wings beneath me.
That dragon on the Peak... I knew her once.
Speak quickly. The blade is restless.
The fire grows. As it should.
Stronger. My oath demands it.
Burn bright, burn true!
Face the last dragon rider.
Dragon fury!
Taste the fire!
Burn!
Ash.
Unworthy.
Wounds only feed the fire.
I have survived worse. Barely.
You will burn for that!
Another flame goes out. No more!
The fire rests. For now.
As it was in the age of dragons.
Well fought, companions.
Embers can still start fires. We rise again.
Not like this. Not yet.
Shinies! Get the shinies!
Stabby time!
Hehehe! Mine now!
*Grrrrr...*
*AWOOOOO!*
Spirits! Bite them!
Ooga mend!
Who dares enter MY forest? CRUSH THEM!
Bring me their shinies and their boots!
GROUND SMASH!
KING SMASH!
Not... fair... the candle man promised...
*rattle rattle*
Fresh... meat...
The master rises. You will kneel.
Wither!
*creak* ...aim... *creak*
The living always come to me in the end. You are merely early.
Your bones will serve me well.
Dark nova!
Feel the cold of the grave.
Fools... the army was never mine...
SMASH PUNY HEROES!
WAAAAGH!
The crimson banner calls!
*SKREEEE!*
Feed the fire! Feed the dragon!
Burn in her name!
Little heroes. I have burned kingdoms.
Drakon? So the last rider crawls back to me.
BURN!
Kneel in the flames!
The sky... was ours...
